answer: Put Endorsed irrigation ditch rider log with water district confirmation at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 729 aliases would need 729 separate proofs, each costing about 119 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The orchard test is the live device, the pearl test is the locked stake, and the hollow test is the graded history no template can fake. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
